map.容器壁残留、烛芯无法吸到的部分与底部余蜡通常不可燃，按 15% 扣减是行业常用的: Residue on the container wall, the part the wick cannot reach and the wax left at the bottom are usually non-combustible; deducting 15% is a common industry rule of thumb, and the real value also depends on the container shape.
map.按每天燃烧 4 小时的假设折算使用天数，用于产品标注与成本评估。: Convert to usable days assuming 4 hours of burning per day, for product labelling and cost evaluation.
map.按蜡烛重量、蜡材类型、烛芯数量与环境温度估算总燃烧时长与可用天数。: Estimate total burn time and usable days from candle weight, wax type, wick count and ambient temperature.
map.直径过大时火焰热量不足以熔化到边缘，会形成“隧道效应”浪费蜡材；一般直径超过 1: When the diameter is too large the flame cannot melt wax out to the edge, forming a "tunnel effect" that wastes wax; for diameters over 100 mm it is generally advisable to use multiple wicks and let each burn long enough to level the melted pool.
map.自制蜡烛时对比大豆蜡、石蜡、蜂蜡等的燃速差异，选出符合目标时长的配方。: When making candles at home, compare the burning rates of soy wax, paraffin, beeswax and others to pick a formula that hits the target burn time.

map.：200 g 大豆蜡单芯、温度系数 1.0：有效蜡量 = 200×0.85 =: : 200 g soy wax, single wick, temperature coefficient 1.0: effective wax = 200*0.85 = 170 g; burn rate = 7*1*1 = 7 g/h; burn time = 170/7 ≈ 24.3 hours; burning 4 hours a day gives about 6 usable days. Switching to a double wick, burn rate = 7*1.7 = 11.9 g/h and the duration drops to about 14.3 hours.
map.：有效蜡量 = 重量 × 0.85（约 15% 为残留不可燃）；烛芯系数：1 根: : effective wax = weight x 0.85 (about 15% is non-combustible residue); wick factor: 1 wick = 1, 2 wicks ≈ 1.7, 3 wicks ≈ 2.3 (more wicks accelerate non-linearly); combined burn rate = base wax burn rate x wick factor x temperature factor; burn hours = effective wax / combined burn rate; usable days = burn hours / 4. Base burn rates (g/h): beeswax 6, soy wax 7, coconut wax 7.5, blended wax 8, palm wax 8.5, paraffin 9.
